name: Rewind
description: Notes played backwards: each key swells up out of nothing, brightens and lands on its strike, then stops dead or rings on forwards.

params.name: Source
params.description: The struck sound that is turned round: a piano string, a bell, a plucked string or a singing bowl. Heard from the next note.

params.name: Strike
params.description: When the note lands. After swell lands it a set time after the key goes down. On release keeps it hovering while the key is held and lands it as the key lets go.

params.name: Swell
params.description: How long the backwards note takes to reach its strike. Short is a quick rush into the note; long is a slow tide. Heard from the next note.

params.name: Tail
params.description: What follows the strike. At zero the note stops dead, as a tape turned round does; higher lets the same note ring on forwards, up to its full natural decay.

params.name: Snap
params.description: How hard the strike itself is: a last surge of the note and a short backwards hammer noise just before it lands. At zero the note arrives smoothly.

params.name: Rise
params.description: How late the sound arrives. Low is early and even, a steady climb; high holds it back until just before the strike. Heard from the next note.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Balance of the overtones. Lower is rounder and darker, mostly the fundamental; higher is brighter and thinner, with more of the late overtones.

params.name: Ghost
params.description: A backwards room ahead of the note: a soft, wide wash of its overtones that comes up early and gathers into the strike.

params.name: Wobble
params.description: Slow tape wow on every note at once: the pitch drifts a little up and down around the played note. At zero the pitch is steady.

params.name: Shimmer
params.description: A second copy of the note a little apart in pitch and place, so the overtones beat slowly against each other, the high ones faster.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the overtones, the second copy and the ghost spread between the speakers. At zero the instrument is mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many strikes land together.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Each source is a short table of partials (ratio, level, decay) played backwards in closed form, with no tape and no buffer; the hammer is a noise burst and the room a narrow band of noise on each partial. It is not a model of any one instrument or product.
